text_en: There is an evil that I have seen under the sun, and it lies heavy upon humankind:
text_cn: 我看见在太阳下，另有一种不幸，重压在人身上：

text_en: those to whom God gives wealth, possessions, and honor, so that they lack nothing of all that they desire, yet God does not enable them to enjoy these things, but a stranger enjoys them. This is vanity; it is a grievous ill.
text_cn: 有一人，天主赐他富裕、钱财、光荣；凡他心中所愿意的，一件也不缺；但天主没有让他享用这一切，却让外人享用了：这也是空虚，是一件很悲惨的事。

text_en: A man may beget a hundred children, and live many years; but however many are the days of his years, if he does not enjoy life’s good things, or has no burial, I say that a stillborn child is better off than he.
text_cn: 有一人生有百子，活了很大岁数，他年纪虽高，却没有随心享受福乐，且未得安葬，照我看来，他还不如流产的胎儿。

text_en: For it comes into vanity and goes into darkness, and in darkness its name is covered;
text_cn: 流产的胎儿徒然而来，悄然而去，他的名字也湮(yān)没无闻；

text_en: moreover it has not seen the sun or known anything; yet it finds rest rather than he.
text_cn: 他没有见过天日，也没有任何知觉，但他总比那人更享安宁。

text_en: Even though he should live a thousand years twice over, yet enjoy no good—do not all go to one place?
text_cn: 那人即便活了两千岁，如未享受福乐，他们二人岂不是同归一处？

text_en: All human toil is for the mouth, yet the appetite is not satisfied.
text_cn: 人的一切劳碌都是为了口腹，但他的欲望却总不知满足。

text_en: For what advantage have the wise over fools? And what do the poor have who know how to conduct themselves before the living?
text_cn: 智者较愚者究有什么利益？知道如何与人往来的穷人，能得什么好处？

text_en: Better is the sight of the eyes than the wandering of desire; this also is vanity and a chasing after wind.
text_cn: 眼看见过的总胜过心所想望的：这也是空虚，也是追风。

text_en: Whatever has come to be has already been named, and it is known what human beings are, and that they are not able to dispute with those who are stronger.
text_cn: 已往所有的，都已有名可称；人为何物，都已知道；人决不能与强于自己的抗辩。

text_en: The more words, the more vanity, so how is one the better?
text_cn: 说话多，必多空谈：这对人能有什么益处？

text_en: For who knows what is good for mortals while they live the few days of their vain life, which they pass like a shadow? For who can tell them what will be after them under the sun?
text_cn: 在空虚，消逝如影的人生少数岁月内，有谁知道什么事对人有益？又有谁能给人指示，他身后在太阳下要发生什么事？
